set.body:
Source: Q-06 security gap exposed by v1 evidence audit.

Scope:
- Reject managed persistence of request environment values by default.
- Permit only application-declared, validated non-secret public environment names through an explicit policy.
- Apply admission before canonical bytes, intent, outbox, or journal state exist.
- Keep rejected values out of diagnostics and preserve replay of previously admitted canonical bytes.
- Document that opaque script bytes remain caller content and must not embed credentials.

Acceptance:
- Default managed controller rejects nonempty environment with no state mutation.
- Explicit public-name policy accepts only its validated allowlist.
- Rejection evidence exposes names/reasons but not values.
- Canonical replay validates admitted bytes without re-running current admission policy.
- Scala 3.7.4 local v1 gate passes.
set.title: P6d: Make durable environment admission fail closed
